meta.note: Boundaries: PfE 2024 allocations and MDC boundaries from GMCA (OGL v3); MCC SRF areas from the council's illustrative My Maps layer; other sites from GMCA 2025 land supply plots; remainder hand-digitised indicative. See properties.boundary_source / confidence.

properties.name: Victoria North
properties.lead: Manchester City Council + Far East Consortium (FEC)
properties.commercial: City River Park c.46 ha; Sandhills Metrolink stop; schools, health centre
properties.milestone: 430 homes complete, 550 on site, 4,800+ consented. Shortlisted as a New Town (final list due end 2026). St Catherine's Wood delivered Jul 2026. Collyhurst Ph2 (550 homes) application due autumn 2026.
properties.summary: Formerly Northern Gateway. Seven neighbourhoods along the Irk valley north of Victoria: Red Bank (5,500 homes), Collyhurst, New Cross, Lower Irk Valley, Sandhills and Vauxhall. Victoria Riverside (634 homes) complete; Falcon and Kingfisher next.

properties.name: Piccadilly SRF / NPR station
properties.lead: Manchester City Council; Bennetts Associates (2014/2018 SRF)
properties.architects: Bennetts Associates (SRF); refresh team to be appointed Jan 2027
properties.commercial: c.820,000 m² commercial; Piccadilly Central c.8m sq ft
properties.milestone: NPR agreements signed Jan 2026; underground vs surface station still undecided. £250k SRF refresh tendered Sep 2026 (also covers Mayfield, Sister, Portugal St East, East Village); contract from Jan 2027.
properties.summary: Station-led growth framework east of Piccadilly. HS2 Manchester leg cancelled 2023; Northern Powerhouse Rail Liverpool–Manchester line now the driver (2030s).

properties.name: Mayfield
